scope: Dragging the active member of a desktop tabbed panel group to a canvas edge separates it into a dock track and places that dock using the existing allowlisted three-region order. One workspace Undo/Redo step changes both group mode and order. The remembered group side is retained for regrouping. Mobile single-drawer behavior is unchanged.

runtime_contracts.mobile_behavior: single drawer; drag reordering is desktop-only
runtime_contracts.undo_redo: one existing workspace history snapshot contains both panelMode and dockOrder
runtime_contracts.group_exit: active dock dropped on canvas before/after edge changes panelMode to separate and updates dockOrder atomically
runtime_contracts.group_side: retained after separating so regrouping preference remains available
runtime_contracts.hidden_group_member_geometry: saved allowlisted dockOrder is used because display:none member coordinates are not a valid ordering source

reused_project_patterns: Existing desktop dock drag lifecycle, cancellation guards, and live-region announcements
Existing allowlisted dock-order preference and tabbed dock CSS Grid layout
Existing Workspace Appearance one-snapshot Undo/Redo and persistence adapter
Existing real-Chromium Playwright fixture and Page Model/API write counter
benchmark_review: The canonical plan's 2026-11-02/03 Dockview review already records its MIT license and broader grid/floating model. A full external docking engine is not needed to split this two-panel group into the existing three reserved regions; use of the in-house shell contract is narrower and does not add a dependency or floating-over-canvas behavior.
